summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Vizinho PWA iteration 3 with enhanced mobile UX improvements. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate - 34/34 tests passed). Frontend PWA features excellent with improved mobile layout, bottom navigation with active indicators, successful encuesta creation/voting, and overall great user experience. React Native project structure confirmed at /app/vizinho-mobile/.
